attempts.summary: Configured a persistent firewalld host firewall on node1 (RHEL 10) allowing only SSH (tcp/22) and tcp/8080, rejecting all other unrelated inbound traffic. Removed a pre-existing cockpit service exception since it was unrelated to the requirement. Verified via nft ruleset inspection (authoritative, since same-host curl to the node's own IP routes over loopback and bypasses interface-scoped firewall rules) that filter_IN_public_allow permits only tcp/22 and tcp/8080, with unmatched inbound traffic hitting reject-with-icmpx-admin-prohibited. Confirmed persistence: firewalld enabled+active, permanent config matches runtime config. Completed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, issued systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed a new boot_id proving an actual restart, and reconfirmed firewalld active/enabled with the identical SSH+8080-only ruleset and sshd active post-restart.
